question: What is the name of the new programme launched by the National Commission for Women (NCW) in May 2025 for college students to promote gender sensitivity, raise awareness on the prevention of sexual harassment and address cyber crimes impacting students?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Campus Calling Abhiyaan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Commission for Women (NCW)** launched the **Campus Calling Abhiyaan** in **May 2025** specifically designed for **college and university students** across India.
 
• The primary objective of the **Campus Calling Abhiyaan** is to promote **gender sensitivity** and create a safe environment within educational ecosystems by engaging with the youth directly.
 
• It aims to raise significant awareness regarding the **prevention of sexual harassment**, ensuring that students are well-versed with the legal protections and redressal mechanisms available to them. ***Hence, the correct option is Campus Calling Abhiyaan.***
 
• A major component of this programme is addressing the rising tide of **cyber crimes** impacting the student community, including issues like **cyberstalking**, **identity theft**, and **online bullying**.
